name: kovapdf
title: KovaPDF
description: Compress and merge PDFs, check PDF signatures and convert Bijoy text to Unicode Bangla with KovaPDF. Requires a KovaPDF account and API key.
author: kovapdf

commands.name: compress-pdf
commands.title: Compress PDF
commands.subtitle: KovaPDF
commands.description: Makes the PDFs selected in Finder smaller. The smaller copy is saved next to each original.

preferences.name: level
preferences.title: Level
preferences.description: Basic keeps good quality, Strong makes it smallest, Quality changes the least.

commands.name: merge-pdfs
commands.title: Merge PDFs
commands.subtitle: KovaPDF
commands.description: Joins the PDFs selected in Finder into one, in name order. The merged PDF is saved next to the first.

commands.name: verify-signature
commands.title: Verify PDF Signature
commands.subtitle: KovaPDF
commands.description: Checks every digital signature in the PDF selected in Finder.

commands.name: bijoy-to-unicode
commands.title: Bijoy to Unicode
commands.subtitle: KovaPDF
commands.description: Converts the selected Bijoy text to Unicode Bangla, then pastes or copies it.

preferences.name: output
preferences.title: Result
preferences.description: Paste the Unicode text in place of the selection, or copy it.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A key from your KovaPDF dashboard (Developer API), starting kova_live_ or kova_test_.
